title: Fix VCS Crate Compile Errors
description: cargo check -p semio-framework-renderer-wgpu fails because its dependency vcs (vcs/rs/lib.rs) does not compile at the current committed HEAD (verified no local diff on vcs/rs/lib.rs — genuine baseline breakage). Errors: (1) lib.rs:1507,1564 — no method into_json for struct Response (ureq 2.12.1 per Cargo.toml/lock, should have this method — investigate if Response in scope is shadowed by another import or ureq API changed); (2) lib.rs:636 — no method pump for &mut DocumentVcsStore<P, Op>, compiler suggests bump — likely rename/typo; (3) lib.rs:639 — no method flush_outbound for &mut DocumentVcsStore<P, Op>; (4) lib.rs:934 — no method sync for &Box<dyn Backbone> — likely Backbone trait out of scope, needs use import; (5) lib.rs:942 — same pattern for load on &Box<dyn Backbone>. Fix vcs/rs/lib.rs so cargo check -p vcs and cargo check -p semio-framework-renderer-wgpu succeed. Do not touch panel-tab / ribbon-levels related code (separate ticket in flight: RIBBON-LEVELS-FOR-NAVBAR-TABS-AND-WINDOW-TOOLBAR).
summary: Re-verified the reported vcs/rs/lib.rs compile break (into_json, pump/flush_outbound, Backbone::sync/load) and it no longer reproduces: `cargo check -p vcs` and `cargo check -p semio-framework-renderer-wgpu` both finish clean (exit 0, only pre-existing dead-code/unused-variable warnings). git diff confirms vcs/rs/lib.rs has zero local changes and matches committed HEAD, so a concurrent session already landed the fix (pump/bump/flush_outbound and the Backbone trait's sync/load are all present and in-scope in the current file). No code changes were made or needed; vcs/rs/lib.rs was read-only investigated.
